To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the application of social media to the assessment of ecosystem services is a promising tool to inform environmental management practices in developing countries, (ii) the recreational value of wetlands in Kerala is substantial, and (iii) the restoration of water quality and wetland area extension could significantly improve the recreational value of the state's wetland ecosystems.

(1) the recreational ecosystem service value of the wetland network in Kerala is currently 2.2 billion US$ per year; (2) improving the water quality of wetlands could increase recreational visits by 350,000 annually, and; (3) restoration of wetland ecosystems could increase the recreational service value of the state’s wetland network by 1.3 billion US$ per annum.
